title: Driver Earnings and Wayfare Pro Training Notes: Late-Settlement Credit on Quest Rewards
content:
**The rule.** A quest reward credited under **Driver Earnings and Wayfare Pro** includes a late-settlement credit, which follows how many calendar days the settlement comes after the quest's payout date, counted from the payout date, which is 3 calendar days after the window end date, to the settlement date: 7 or more days earn 2.00 for each of those days; at least one but fewer than 7 days earn the flat 5.00; a settlement on or before the payout date earns nothing. The quest is the account's most recently ended quest, and its window end date is the one on the quest offer.

The credit is a USD amount added to the stated reward amount after any multiplication of that stated amount; it is not itself multiplied, and the sum is rounded half up to the cent once, at the end.

**Q. How is the payout date found?** It is the window end date of the quest plus 3 calendar days: a window ending on 10 May has its payout date on 13 May.

**Q. Once the settlement is 7 or more days late, how many days are paid?** Every one of those days, counted from the payout date: 9 days late earns 18.00 (2.00 for each of the 9 days).

**Q. What happens between 1 and 6 days late?** A flat 5.00, whatever the number of days in that band.

## Dated illustration (hypothetical quest whose window ends on 10 May; payout date 13 May)

| Settlement date | Days after the payout date | Late-settlement credit (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| 12 May | Before the payout date | 0.00 |
| 13 May | 0 | 0.00 |
| 14 May | 1 | 5.00 |
| 19 May | 6 | 5.00 |
| 20 May | 7 | 14.00 |
| 22 May | 9 | 18.00 |
